description: This file implements a filesystem-backed cache layer for storing book metadata and assets in a digital book reader application. It manages a JSON index of metadata, asset storage, retrieval, and cache staleness validation.

classes.name: CacheStatus
classes.description: Represents the status of a cache lookup for metadata, including whether data was found, if it's stale, and the metadata content.

classes.name: FilesystemCache
classes.description: A cache layer that stores metadata and assets on the filesystem with TTL validation and concurrency-safe index management.

methods.name: None put_metadata(self, source: str, book_id: str, metadata: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Stores or updates metadata for a specified source and book ID.

methods.name: CacheStatus get_metadata(self, source: str, book_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves metadata and indicates if it is stale based on TTL.

methods.name: Path put_asset(self, source: str, book_id: str, filename: str, data: bytes)
methods.description: Stores an asset file (e.g., cover image or book file) associated with a specific source and book ID.

methods.name: Optional[Path] get_asset_path(self, source: str, book_id: str, filename: str)
methods.description: Returns the path to a stored asset file if it exists.

methods.name: Optional[bytes] get_asset_bytes(self, source: str, book_id: str, filename: str)
methods.description: Reads and returns the bytes of a stored asset if it exists.

methods.name: bool has_fresh_metadata(self, source: str, book_id: str)
methods.description: Checks whether metadata exists and is not stale according to TTL.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] purge_stale(self)
methods.description: Removes stale metadata entries from the index, returning total and removed counts.

methods.name: None __init__(self, root: Optional[str] = None, ttl_seconds: Optional[int] = None)
